messages:
maria: Quick check — from the INC-347 postmortem we still have a handful of cross-team actions that need owners + firm due dates. Can people confirm ownership so we can close the RCA checklist?

jake: I can take the rollout doc update (action #3). Targeting EOD Mon (Mar 23). Will PR to the runbooks repo and ping for review.

kevin: I own action #7 (model fallback tuning + canary). Plan: run a 24h canary next Thursday (Mar 26), then push config if stable. Need infra help for a dedicated canary pool.

sarah: I'll set up the canary pool and quota. ETA Wed (Mar 25) to have infra ready. @kevin can you post the canary traffic profile?

kevin: Sure — profile below, will attach to the ticket.
```
requests_per_minute: 50
burst: 200
seq_len: 512
duration: 24h
```

maria: Great. For visibility I'm listing the outstanding items I have: 
- action-3: rollout doc (owner: jake) — due Mar 23
- action-7: model fallback canary (owner: kevin + infra:sarah) — canary Mar 26, final config Mar 30
- action-11: add token-level cost dashboard for the route (owner: ???) — needs owner
- action-14: add automated alert for KV cache thrash (owner: ???) — needs owner

jake: I can triage action-11, but will need somebody from analytics to wire the dashboard. @maria can you route to analytics?

maria: Yep will @mention analytics team on the ticket and add required metrics. Tentatively due Apr 2.

kevin: For action-14 (KV thrash alert) I can draft the alert rules, but will need SRE to add escalation policy. @sarah want to own final rollout?

sarah: I can own rollout + escalation config. Put me down for Apr 1.

maria: Ok updated owner map in the RCA ticket (INC-347/actions). Please add your PR/issue links as they land. If you can't meet the dates, drop a quick note here so we can reassign before the next review (Mar 29).

ops-bot: Reminder — postmortem action review scheduled: 2026-03-29 16:00 UTC. Meeting link: https://zoom.redwood.example/pm-review

jake: Thanks all — tagging final confirmations: jake ✅ Mar 23, kevin ✅ canary Mar 26, sarah ✅ infra + rollout Apr 1, maria ✅ analytics handoff Apr 2.

maria: Perfect. Closing loop — I'll follow up on Mar 24 to verify progress and collate PRs. :white_check_mark:
